Definition: Chagaba or Chagabah, one of the Nethinim
BiblicalUsage: Hagabah is named twice, once in each return list, spelled Hagabah in Ezra and Hagaba in Nehemiah — the children of Hagabah among the Nethinim who came back from exile. Two lists, two spellings, one family that came home.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name kept in two lists, with two spellings, is a person God brought home twice over.
